# Remote Logger for Home Assistant

> Remote Logging for Home Assistant using Syslog or OTEL

Remote Logger is a Home Assistant custom integration (installed via HACS) that forwards Home Assistant log records and selected events to a remote Syslog server or an OpenTelemetry (OTLP) collector, with structured multi-line entries and stack traces.


## Getting started

- [HomeAssistant Remote Logger](https://remote-logger.rhizomatics.org.uk/index.md): Overview, installation, configuration and supported protocols

## Guides

- [Event Logging](https://remote-logger.rhizomatics.org.uk/events/index.md): Logging Home Assistant events as well as log records
- [Log Aggregators](https://remote-logger.rhizomatics.org.uk/aggregators/index.md): Log aggregators known to work with Syslog and OTLP
